No gate or provenance blocker requires re-running before proceeding.",
  "summary": "A strong, gate-passing live Project Model v1 that accurately captures fmc-mcp's read-only FMC MCP server architecture: complete runtime contracts, external surfaces, invariants (including rate limits, secret redaction, read-only vs auth-POST), safe quality gates, and excellent source-derived backlog/open questions, with provider metadata and no sign of a cached prior model. It falls short of GOOD on two real quality points — the test suite is ranked #1 high-risk above the production client and profiled with production tags drawn from Test* symbols, and responsibility summaries are formulaic with the client profile omitting explicit retry/endpoint-wrapper language. These are quality weaknesses, not must-have failures, so the verdict is MIXED."
